title: Mortgage Loan File Underwriting Guidelines: Conditions, Suspense and Resubmission
content:
**Decision service level.** A processed Mortgage Loan File is submitted to underwriting and receives a decision within the program's underwriting turn time in business days.

**When conditions may be worked.** Conditions are issued, cleared or waived only while the loan file status is underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close.

**Due dates.** Each issued condition is due the program's condition response period in calendar days after its issued date (the issued date is day zero).

**Clearing.** Documents received are reviewed within the program's condition review turn time in business days. A condition is cleared only by a document that answers it and whose document date is no more than the program's credit document age limit in days old on the expected note date (the file's estimated closing date); an older document leaves the condition open and a fresh one is requested.

**Deposits and gifts.** A single deposit at or above the program's large deposit threshold must be sourced with a large deposit explanation condition; gift funds need a gift letter condition and are acceptable only where the program allows gift funds.

**Verbal verification of employment.** The verbal verification of employment condition is a prior-to-funding condition and is cleared only by a verification dated within the program's verbal verification period in business days before the note date.

**Waivers.** A condition is waived only when the fact it tests no longer applies to the file or another document already on file satisfies it; a borrower's request alone never waives a condition.

**Suspense.** When any prior-to-documents condition is past its due date and unanswered — an issued prior-to-documents condition with no cleared or waived record resolving it, whose due date is earlier than today — the file is suspended and its suspended date is stamped. A suspended file is resubmitted when every overdue condition is answered, adding one to its resubmission count; after the program's number of resubmissions allowed before senior review, the next decision belongs to a senior underwriter.

## Cases (hypothetical files, 10-day response period, 120-day document age limit)

- A condition issued on 3 May is due on 13 May. On 14 May it is still open with no cleared or waived record, so it is overdue; if it is a prior-to-documents condition the file is suspended and the suspended date is stamped.
- A bank statement dated 120 days before the estimated closing date is within the age limit and may clear the condition it answers; one dated 121 days before is too old, the condition stays open and a fresh statement is requested.
- A borrower asks that a gift letter condition be dropped. The request alone does not waive it; it is waived only if the fact it tests no longer applies or another document already on file satisfies it.

## Status table

| Loan file status | Conditions may be issued, cleared or waived |
|---|---|
| underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended, clear to close | yes |
| application received, disclosed, processing | no |
